sources.title: Census QuickFacts: San Francisco city
sources.denominator: Households or occupied housing units; not individual adults
sources.used_as: Citywide reference anchors, not neighborhood household or individual-income targets

sources.title: BLS Occupational Employment and Wages, San Francisco-Oakland-Fremont, May 2024
sources.denominator: Employer jobs across the metro, not resident workers or SF-city jobs
sources.used_as: Wage level proxies only; sector mapping and individual spread are assumptions

sources.title: SF OLSE historical minimum wage rates
sources.used_as: Scenario floor for baseline wages; exceptions not modeled

sources.title: SF 2024 Point-in-Time Count report
sources.denominator: People observed experiencing homelessness on one night, not annual prevalence or an ACS adult household rate
sources.used_as: Context only; never divided by neighborhood adults or used to force unhoused agents

mapping.note: One game day is one budget day. Annual gross wage / 365 / 25 gives daily gross credits, then multiply by assumed take-home fraction. Rent is monthly USD * 12 / 365 / 25. Two completed baseline shifts earn the full daily wage; no passive salary is also paid.

scenario.note: All distributions, hours, take-home fraction, support, savings, household grouping, service supply and business/housing thresholds are scenario assumptions, not measured marginals, benefit entitlements, legal eviction rules, or real company forecasts. They are independent of identity and ambitions.
